title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — Cancelling a Plan
content:
**Terms in force.** Cancelling a **Selling Plans** plan is the seller's own decision and is confirmed by the seller. The Individual Seller Plan closes immediately. A monthly-term store cancellation is scheduled for the end of the current billing period, and an annual-term store cancellation for the end of the term. A seller on an annual term may instead end the term immediately; the plan closes. A scheduled cancellation may be withdrawn only before its effective date. Closing a plan never cancels fees already billed; they remain collectable from the payments balance.

> **Retired clauses — no longer in force.** "an early termination fee of the early termination share" and "times the remaining committed monthly fees (whole months from the next billing date to the term end) is billed" — no longer in force, together with the computation they carried (the annual term monthly fee times the remaining months times the early termination share, rounded to the nearest cent). They are superseded by the current basis. The early termination fee share of each plan, which these clauses read for every tier from the Individual Seller Plan to the Enterprise Store, remains the figure on the plan schedule.

## When a cancellation takes effect

| Plan and term | Effect of the seller's cancellation |
|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | The plan closes immediately |
| Store plan on the monthly term | Scheduled for the end of the current billing period; the plan shows cancellation scheduled with the date the cancellation will take effect |
| Store plan on the annual term | Scheduled for the end of the term |
| Store plan on the annual term, seller ends the term immediately | The plan closes |

When the scheduled date is reached, the plan closes and the closing date is recorded.

## Withdrawing a scheduled cancellation

The cut-off is the cancellation effective date shown on the plan record, with a lead time of 0 days: the withdrawal must come before that date, and the effective date itself is excluded. A withdrawn cancellation returns the plan to active and clears the effective date.

**Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical effective date of 1 July).** A withdrawal on 30 June is before the effective date and is possible. A withdrawal on 1 July is not before the effective date and is not possible.

## Points of judgement

- **Whose decision.** Only the seller decides to cancel, and the seller confirms it.
- **Fees already billed.** Closing the plan leaves every fee already billed in place, collectable from the payments balance.
